description.content: Submit a single Tax Identification Number (TIN) for validation. Supports instant lookup and cached result retrieval across 120+ countries. The API returns either an immediate response (200) or an accepted async response (202).

response.name: Immediate response for validations. Provides format validity details. Also returned for TINs with invalid format or checksum digits.
